newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: New Clicks says new stores to boost yr shr.
newsitem.headline: New Clicks says new stores to boost yr shr.

text.p: South Africa's New Clicks Holdings Ltd said on Monday the planned opening of 50 new stores this year would allow it to meet its forecast 20 to 25 percent earnings growth for the full year.
The plan brings the group's total number of stores to 400.

New Clicks said the unbundling of consumer group Malbak Ltd, which has a 51 percent stake in the firm, would be a positive development as its shares will become more freely traded and no shareholder will have more than 35 percent of the group.

New Clicks shares owned by Malbak are to be distributed to Malbak shareholders on April 29 at a conversion rate of 37.763 New Clicks shares for every 100 Malbak shares held. The last day to register as a Malbak shareholder is April 25, the firm said.
It added the change in financial year had skewed the reporting periods and the newly listed New Clicks was a different entity from the former Clicks group, whose assets it had acquired.
Earlier New Clicks posted earnings per share of 15.7 cents in the six months to February 1997 against 18.1 cents in the 10 months to August 31, 1996.
